name: bims-city-atlas
description: Static-first city atlas data foundation for source-backed urban changelog artifacts.

scripts.build: npm run build:data && npm run build:events && npm run build:transit && npm run build:manifest && npm run verify
scripts.verify: npm run verify:data && node scripts/verify_no_legacy_paths.js && node scripts/verify-manifest.js && npm run verify:proposal
scripts.verify:browser: node scripts/browser_smoke.js && node scripts/dashboard_smoke.js && npm run verify:timeline-imagery
scripts.coverage:python: coverage run -m unittest discover tests && coverage report --fail-under=80
scripts.test: npm run build:data && npm run verify:data && npm run verify:proposal && npm run coverage:python
